I connect business, financial and operational requirements to executable domain models, integration contracts and verification cases. My work combines direct implementation, team development and AI-assisted engineering, with an emphasis on reliable systems that remain practical to change.
about: I work across software engineering, domain modeling, architecture and technical leadership. My experience spans ERP, lending, banking, payments and data-collection platforms, with accounting and finance as recurring areas of depth rather than a restriction to one industry.

I connect product, economic and operational requirements to the models that software implements. I use documentation, working code and representative and adverse cases to clarify rules, challenge assumptions and guide changes.

I remain hands-on while working with engineers, product and operations. My current work includes financial-system design and development, reusable domain tools and AI-assisted engineering workflows. I focus on preserving reliable behavior and making expected changes less costly to implement.
